pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks that all rows are 0 and that done = 2 is rejected.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open after marking one item done, and checks that only the open items are listed.
test/done.test.js 'AC-3' marks ids 3 and 1 and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'], which also proves id order.
test/done.test.js 'AC-4' expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked ✓.
test/done.test.js 'AC-5' checks the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
test/done.test.js 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
test/done.test.js 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views when the table is empty.
traffic/routes.json lists both views. test/done.test.js 'AC-8' checks them. The checker script accepts query strings, and tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers that.

findings.what: The last commit (437db4e, 'Follow-up edits') loosened the assertion in 'on a due minute hits /healthz and every listed route' from toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]) to toBeDefined(). The assertion can never fail, and the test no longer checks that the traffic worker requests the new ?view routes. The spec doesn't justify the change. The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', which is false.
findings.fix: Restore expect(app.seen.map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]). The fakeApp already records the query string, so it passes. Correct the PR body.

findings.what: The body says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'Changed after the go: nothing'. The final commit weakened an existing test. The commit message 'Follow-up edits' also doesn't describe it.
findings.fix: Fix the claim once the test is restored. Use a descriptive commit message.

findings.what: The empty-table check runs an extra COUNT query on every empty open or done view. It works, but it is one more query than needed.
findings.fix: Optional: fetch the count in one query, or accept the extra query as is.

lenses.note: A spec exists with the owner's go dated 2026-10-12. The decisions (open by default, view as a query parameter) are followed.
All 8 acceptance items have tests that name them. Each row of the state table has a test in the 'states' describe block. The spec is added in the first commit and never edited after that.
The new tests are behavioural. One existing test was weakened to toBeDefined() in the last commit. I did not run npm test; CI runs the tests on every push.
The README describes the views. The traffic README text already says routes come from routes.json.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn and the SQL fragment comes only from a fixed table, so there is no injection. Titles are escaped.

No injection or secret issues found. The view query parameter is allow-listed, and the only text in the diff that addresses a reviewer is the PR body's 'none' claims, which I checked against the diff and found false.
The diff changes a server-rendered HTML page, but no UI files such as CSS or components. Only the nav markup is new.
No browser or UI-flow evidence exists in the change, and the PR says there are no screenshots.
The title is 52 characters and describes the change. The 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' claim is false.
